metadata.description: Claude plugins from InventDB. Each one runs a line of business from Claude on the customer's own InventDB Serverless workspace: the records stay in the workspace, and InventDB applies each person's access to every read and write.

plugins.name: inventdb-legal
plugins.description: Run a law firm's matters, docket, conflict checks, time, billing, trust and documents from Claude, on an InventDB Serverless workspace.

plugins.name: inventdb-pms
plugins.description: Run a rental portfolio from Claude: rent roll and arrears, renewals, maintenance and vendors, receipts into expenses, owner statements and year-end figures, on your own InventDB Serverless workspace.

plugins.name: inventdb-freelance
plugins.description: Run a consulting practice from Claude: scope checks against signed SOWs, retainer burn and overage, effective hourly rate, unbilled time, overdue invoices and deliverables, on your own InventDB Serverless workspace.

plugins.name: inventdb-recruiter
plugins.description: Run an independent recruiting desk from Claude: search your own resumes by what people have done, shortlist for open roles, chase follow-ups, and track placements, fees and guarantees, on your own InventDB Serverless workspace.

plugins.name: inventdb-consulting
plugins.description: Run consulting work such as a buyer's due diligence from Claude: search and cross-check the data room, keep a cited findings register, chase outstanding requests, record research, prepare printable reports and keep the timesheet, on your own InventDB Serverless workspace.
